verdict.rationale: Jira documents its own automation capability: Rovo AI custom automations covering 'automated reminders to rules that move work forward' (jira-docs-4), and automation that connects tools to any Jira workflow (jira-intdir-1, jira-docs-22). Automated reminders imply time-based triggers, but no evidence explicitly describes scheduled or recurring triggers, so the story's core is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron or recurring-event triggers, detail on how engineers configure recurring rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
